breadcrumb.context: Accessible label of the current folder breadcrumb above the mail list.

breadcrumb_hidden_folders.context: Screen reader text of the "…" item replacing the middle folders of a long breadcrumb. {path} is the list of hidden folder names separated by slashes.

breadcrumb_open_hidden_folder.context: Screen reader text of the "…" link of a long breadcrumb, which opens the first hidden folder. {folder} is that folder's name, {path} the list of hidden folder names separated by slashes.

messages_number.context: Displays the number of messages in an mail folder.

loading.context: Screen-reader text announced while the message list is reloading.

refresh.context: Button that reloads the list of messages of the current folder.

folder_not_found.description: Message when folder messages request returns 404

mail_unavailable.description: Message when folder messages request returns 503

retry.description: Button label to refetch folder messages after 503

open_inbox.description: Button label to navigate to INBOX after folder 404

generic.string: Unable to load messages. Please try again later.

label.context: Accessible label of the compact message filter dropdown in the mail list toolbar.
Button of the mail list toolbar opening the label quick filter (mails having every chosen label).

clear.context: Button of the mail list label quick filter removing every chosen label.

move_to.description: Shown under the dragged mail when hovering a valid folder

cannot_drop.description: Shown under the dragged mail when hovering an invalid folder
